# Nier

Nier is a dark theme drawn from NieR: Automata, with a warm mono color scheme, a game-style header font and an H1 underline that gives headings a menu-like look. Internal links are colored differently for existing and missing notes, external links are blue with icons, callouts and code blocks are gentler, and the graph view is color-coded for tags, attachments and notes.

![Nier screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exloseur3d/nier-theme/HEAD/preview_Nier_theme.png)

```cue

    name:   "Nier"
    author: "exloseur3d"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exloseur3d/nier-theme/HEAD/preview_Nier_theme.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a NieR: Automata–inspired interface with a warm mono color scheme, game-style header font, and H1 underline for a menu-like look. Use distinct internal link colors for existing vs missing notes, blue external links with icons, gentler callouts and code blocks, and a color-coded graph view for tags, attachments and notes."
}
```
